request.prompt: Genuine hand-crafted 2D pixel art for a mature overhead exploration RPG. Visible square pixel clusters, controlled 24-color palette, dark 1-pixel style outlines, NO photoreal rendering, NO soft airbrush gradients. Orthographic camera angled down 55 degrees, no vanishing point, no isometric yaw. ONE complete compact adult woman sprite, facing straight toward the BOTTOM edge. Ava Morgan, a 32-year-old New York investment principal, chestnut chin-length bob, ivory open collar, muted copper blazer, dark indigo trousers and brown leather loafers. No bag or badge. Three head-heights tall total, broad readable head and shoulders, short solid legs; mature restrained features. Clearly see crown, shoulder tops, shoe tops; short foreshortened face. Neutral stand: arms down, two feet planted beside each other. Full body centered occupying about 650 pixels of a 1024 canvas, large empty margin. Entire hair and both shoes visible. Uniform opaque saturated magenta #ff00ff background, NO shadow, NO ground, NO props, NO words, NO frame. Every visible body part belongs to one person.
